create_rnn_model: create an RNNModel instance from a list of Haiku modules and callables stacked sequentially
call_rnn_model: call the RNNModel with inputs and previous state to get output and updated state tuple
build_rnn_model_layers: build an RNNModel by composing hk.RNNCore layers with plain hk.Module or callable layers
get_rnn_initial_state: get the initial state tuple for an RNNModel given a batch size
test_rnn_model_forward: test the RNNModel forward pass by feeding inputs through stacked layers and verifying state updates
